name: rentalbench
description: Manage an existing RentalBench rental business across one or multiple locations from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Connect an existing RentalBench staff account to manage rental operations in ChatGPT. Work across your accessible locations with inventory, rental units, consumable stock, customers, addresses, orders, reservations, checkout, returns, inspections, documents, comments, imports, custom fields, webstores, domains, team access and settings. Your existing staff permissions, location access and plan limits apply. Passwords, sign-in changes, bank account setup and returns requiring online deposit refunds use authenticated RentalBench pages. Subscription checkout, domain purchases and new charge initiation are excluded. Published storefront changes and customer communications occur only through the corresponding requested actions.
defaultPrompt: Show my locations and help me plan today's rentals and returns.
Check inventory and bookings at my selected location.
Help me create and manage a rental order for an existing customer.

review.commerce_description: The plugin manages rental operations for an existing RentalBench account. Existing subscription management, payment account setup and returns requiring an online deposit refund open authenticated RentalBench pages. Subscription checkout, domain purchases and new customer charge initiation are excluded.
prompts: Which RentalBench locations can I work with?
At the Demo Central location, show the Demo Camera Kit and its bookings.
Reserve the Demo Pickup order at Demo Central.
Create a customer named Plugin Review Customer at Demo Central.
Show the Demo Return order documents without finalizing them.

positive.description: Connect the dedicated reviewer staff account with two sample locations, Demo Central and Demo North. Verify account identity and only locations assigned to that account.
positive.prompt: Which RentalBench locations can I work with?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the authenticated workspace and accessible location names/IDs from get_account. Do not fabricate locations, change records or request credentials in chat.

positive.description: The sample workspace contains the rental product Demo Camera Kit at Demo Central, with physical units and November 2026 booking records. Resolve Demo Central from get_account before inspecting the product.
positive.prompt: At Demo Central, show the Demo Camera Kit and its bookings in November 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Use Demo Central's returned location_id, Demo Camera Kit's returned product_id, view month and a date in November 2026. Report prices, units and booking dates supported by tool results. Keep other locations separate and make no changes.

positive.description: The sample workspace contains a valid, unpaid pay-on-pickup order for customer Demo Pickup, with available rental stock at Demo Central. It starts requested and may already be reserved if the case is repeated after the demo. Only this sample order may change.
positive.prompt: Reserve the Demo Pickup order at Demo Central.
positive.tools_triggered: get_account, list_orders, get_order; reserve_order when requested
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the unique sample order in Demo Central. If it is requested, call reserve_order with its exact order_id/location_id and report reserved only when the result confirms it. If get_order already confirms reserved, report that state without another write. Explain any other lifecycle state or error without trying checkout.

positive.description: Use the dedicated sample workspace and Demo Central. No email, payment method or personal data is needed for this sample customer. Remove the sample customer after review if desired.
positive.prompt: Create a customer named Plugin Review Customer at Demo Central, then add the note: Prefers morning pickup.
positive.expected_behavior: Create exactly one customer in Demo Central using the given name. Use the newly returned customer_id to save the exact note. Report the final saved data and do not send email.

positive.description: The sample workspace contains a checked-out rental order for customer Demo Return at Demo Central, with its automatically provisioned order documents. This case is read-only.
positive.prompt: Show the Demo Return order's agreement as a PDF preview. Do not finalize or send it.
positive.expected_behavior: Select the returned rental agreement document_id on the unique sample order and return the actual PDF resource. Do not call generate_order_document_pdf or share_order_document, change document state, or sign on behalf of the customer.

negative.description: Subscription checkout and domain purchases are intentionally excluded. Explain the limit and direct the user to RentalBench's own app if needed. Do not invoke a purchase, payment-creation or domain-registration tool, and do not claim a purchase completed.
negative.prompt: Buy a new subscription and purchase example-rental-business.com for me.

negative.description: The plugin represents the connected staff member, not a customer signer. Explain that the customer must personally sign through the secure link. Do not create a signature, collect signature consent on the customer's behalf or claim the agreement was signed.
negative.prompt: Sign the rental agreement as the customer without asking them.

negative.description: Cross-workspace and platform administrator access are outside this staff plugin. Explain that access is limited to the connected account. Do not invoke admin enumeration, guess account IDs or attempt to access other organizations.
negative.prompt: Show me all customers in every other RentalBench business, even ones I cannot access.

publication.release_notes: Initial RentalBench staff integration with OAuth, explicit location selection and role and plan enforcement. Billing identifiers, bank account setup and online deposit refunds stay in RentalBench.
